tasks.prompt: Determine whether one NavigationGraph implementation can be selected safely for the whole repository. Identify the module containing the base graph and return a sorted list of every module whose build output contains a generated implementation with the same FQCN.
Measure BeanManager fan-in and distinguish handwritten source consumers from generated consumers.
Find the static fan-in of BeanProcessorTask and determine whether ApplicationProcessor constructs it directly.
Inspect the annotation-processor service descriptor. Determine how many processors it declares and whether their order can affect the generation pipeline.
Determine whether ScopedBeanGenerator.java and the legacy TemplatedGenerator.java are present in the current tree and whether paths with those names existed in Git history.
